name: Fragrant Lamb Curry
description: A warming midweek curry with tender lamb
method: Cut the lamb into bite-sized chunks. Dice the onions, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Brown the lamb in batches and set aside.
In the same pan, cook the onions for 5 minutes until soft. Add garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and garam masala. Stir for 1 minute.
Return the lamb to the pan. Add the chopped tomatoes and coconut milk. Stir well.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for 1.5 hours until the lamb is tender.
Cook the basmati rice according to packet instructions.
Season the curry with salt to taste and serve over rice, topped with fresh coriander.

name: Classic Spaghetti Bolognese
method: Finely dice the onion, carrot, and celery. Mince the garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pan. Cook the mince over high heat until browned, breaking it up as it cooks. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, soften the onion, carrot, and celery for 8 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Return the mince to the pan. Add chopped tomatoes, tomato puree, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Simmer uncovered on low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook spaghetti according to packet instructions. Drain and toss with the sauce.
Serve with grated parmesan on top.

name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Quick and fun - everyone builds their own
method: Slice the chicken into strips. Mix with paprika, cumin, chilli powder, juice of half the lime, and a pinch of salt.
Slice the peppers and onion into strips.
Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes until cooked through. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, cook the peppers and onion for 4-5 minutes until slightly charred.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss together.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave.
Serve with grated cheddar, soured cream, and lime wedges.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta Bake
description: Comforting cheesy pasta the kids will love
method: Preheat oven to 190°C / 170°C fan / gas 5.
Cook pasta according to packet instructions, drain.
Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Soften in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, cream cheese, basil, salt, and pepper. Stir until the cream cheese melts.
Combine the sauce with pasta and pour into a baking dish.
Top with grated cheddar and bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

name: Fish Pie
description: Classic British comfort food with a creamy mash topping
method: Preheat oven to 200°C / 180°C fan / gas 6. Peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with half the butter and a splash of milk.
Cut the salmon and haddock into chunks.
Melt the remaining butter in a saucepan. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually add the milk, stirring constantly until you have a smooth white sauce.
Add the fish, prawns, peas, and chopped parsley to the sauce. Pour into a baking dish.
Spoon the mash over the top and rough up with a fork. Scatter grated cheddar over.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden on top and bubbling at the edges.

name: Vegetable Stir Fry with Noodles
description: A quick and healthy weeknight dinner
method: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions. Drain and toss with sesame oil.
Cut broccoli into small florets, slice the pepper, julienne the carrots, and halve the pak choi.
Mix soy sauce, honey, and a splash of water for the sauce.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Stir fry garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and carrots, stir fry for 3 minutes. Add pepper and pak choi, cook 2 minutes more.
Add the noodles and sauce, toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve sprinkled with sesame seeds.

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: A hearty classic with lamb mince and veg
method: Preheat oven to 200°C / 180°C fan / gas 6.
Peel and chop potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Dice onion and carrot. Heat oil in a pan and brown the lamb mince. Drain excess fat.
Add onion and carrot, cook for 5 minutes. Stir in tomato puree and Worcestershire sauce.
Dissolve the stock cube in 300ml boiling water and add to the pan. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the peas, then pour into a baking dish. Top with mash and rough up with a fork.
Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: A fresh and filling lunch or light dinner
method: Preheat oven to 200°C / 180°C fan. Tear ciabatta into chunks, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, and bake for 10 minutes until crisp croutons.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan and cook chicken for 6-7 minutes each side until cooked through. Slice.
Make the dressing: mash anchovies with garlic, mix with mayo, lemon juice, 1 tbsp olive oil, and grated parmesan.
Chop the lettuce and arrange on plates. Top with chicken and croutons.
Drizzle with dressing and shave extra parmesan over the top.

name: Thai Green Curry
description: Fragrant and creamy with chicken and veg
method: Cut chicken thighs into chunks. Slice the pepper, trim the green beans, and halve the sweetcorn.
Heat oil in a wok or large pan. Fry the curry paste for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add the vegetables and cook for 8-10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Cook the jasmine rice according to packet instructions.
Stir in fresh basil leaves and serve over rice.

name: Bangers and Mash
description: Classic sausages with onion gravy and mash
method: Preheat oven to 200°C / 180°C fan. Place sausages on a baking tray and cook for 25 minutes, turning halfway.
Peel and chop potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with butter and milk.
Slice the onions. Heat oil in a pan and cook onions on medium-low for 15 minutes until soft and caramelised.
Stir flour into the onions and cook for 1 minute. Dissolve stock cube in 400ml boiling water and gradually add to the pan, stirring. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the peas in boiling water for 3 minutes.
Serve sausages on a pile of mash with onion gravy and peas.

name: Homemade Pizza
description: Fun to make together - customise your own toppings
method: Mix flour, yeast, sugar, salt, olive oil, and 300ml warm water. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and leave to rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled in size.
Preheat oven to 240°C / 220°C fan / gas 9. Place a baking tray in the oven to heat.
Divide dough into 4 balls. Roll each out into a thin circle on a floured surface.
Spread passata over each base. Top with torn mozzarella, pepperoni, sliced mushrooms, and red onion.
Sprinkle with oregano. Bake on the hot tray for 10-12 minutes until crisp and golden.

name: Beef Chilli Con Carne
description: Warming and hearty with rice or nachos
method: Dice the onion and pepper. Mince the garlic.
Heat oil in a large pan. Brown the mince over high heat, breaking it up. Remove and set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper for 5 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, chilli powder, and paprika. Cook for 1 minute.
Return mince to the pan. Add chopped tomatoes, tomato puree, and drained kidney beans.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook basmati rice according to packet instructions.
Serve chilli over rice with soured cream and grated cheddar.

name: Toad in the Hole
description: Golden Yorkshire pudding batter with sausages
method: Make the batter: whisk flour, eggs, milk, and salt until smooth. Rest for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 220°C / 200°C fan / gas 7.
Pour oil into a large roasting tin and add the sausages. Place in the oven for 10 minutes until the oil is smoking hot.
Remove the tin and quickly pour the batter around the sausages. Return to the oven immediately.
Bake for 30 minutes until puffed up and golden. Do not open the oven door during baking.
Meanwhile, make onion gravy: slice onions, caramelise in a pan, stir in a little flour, add 400ml stock. Simmer until thickened.
Cook peas and serve alongside.

name: Salmon with New Potatoes and Green Beans
description: A light and healthy midweek meal
method: Halve or quarter the new potatoes. Boil for 15 minutes until tender. Add green beans for the last 4 minutes.
Season salmon with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon.
Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, flip and cook 3 minutes more.
Drain the potatoes and beans. Toss with butter and chopped dill.
Serve salmon on top with lemon wedges.

name: Chicken and Leek Pie
description: Creamy chicken filling under golden puff pastry
method: Preheat oven to 200°C / 180°C fan / gas 6.
Cut chicken into chunks. Trim and slice the leeks.
Melt butter in a pan. Cook the leeks for 5 minutes until soft. Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually add milk, stirring. Crumble in the stock cube.
Add mustard, salt, and pepper. Simmer for 5 minutes until thickened. Pour into a pie dish.
Lay puff pastry over the top, trim edges, and crimp with a fork. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until the pastry is golden and puffed.

name: Risotto Primavera
description: Creamy Italian rice with seasonal vegetables
method: Dissolve stock cubes in 1.2 litres of boiling water. Keep warm on the hob.
Dice the onion and courgette. Mince the garlic. Cut asparagus into short lengths.
Heat olive oil and half the butter in a wide pan. Soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Add rice and stir for 1 minute. Add stock a ladleful at a time, stirring and waiting for each to be absorbed before adding the next.
After 15 minutes, add courgette and asparagus. Continue adding stock for another 5 minutes. Add peas for the last 2 minutes.
Remove from heat. Stir in remaining butter, grated parmesan, lemon juice, and salt.
Serve immediately - risotto waits for no one.

name: Chicken Katsu Curry
description: Crispy chicken with mild Japanese-style curry sauce
method: Make the sauce: dice onion, mince garlic, grate ginger. Cook in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes. Add curry powder, cook 1 minute.
Add 400ml stock (cube + water), honey, and soy sauce. Simmer 15 minutes then blend until smooth.
Flatten chicken breasts slightly with a rolling pin. Set up three bowls: flour, beaten eggs, panko breadcrumbs.
Coat each chicken in flour, then egg, then panko. Press crumbs on firmly.
Heat remaining oil in a frying pan. Shallow fry chicken for 5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Cook jasmine rice according to packet instructions.
Slice the chicken and serve over rice with the curry sauce poured over.
